comment: Customer 360 drill-through view for Genie: one row per current golden client (legal entity) as of 30-Sep-2026 with its headline attributes (names and aliases for LIKE search, group, segment, tier, industry, coverage office, primary RM, internal and external rating, IFRS 9 stage, EWS band, watchlist, KYC risk) and the latest KPI of every domain: FYTD revenue and RoRWA, products held, open pipeline and next-best product, RM contact; credit limit, drawn, EAD / RWA / ECL, DPD, EWS score, covenant headroom, credit review due; KYC reviews and onboarding; deposits / CASA / TD, payments in the last 90 days, trade outstanding; 30-day cash-flow forecast and the latest liquidity need; signals, news and RM-note sentiment in the last 90 days; source coverage and attribute completeness. Point-in-time KPIs are at the 30-Sep-2026 month-end / day; FYTD = 1-Apr .. 30-Sep-2026 (FY2026 H1). USD amounts; 0 = none. Grain: one row per current golden client.
